observations: Photo shows a flat-screen TV with a thin bezel and dark screen (no on-screen menu visible).
TV appears wall-mounted or mounted on a stand/fixture; only the front is clearly visible.
No visible brand/model text on the bezel or back in the photo.
No visible screen damage is clearly shown, but the screen is off/reflecting.

claims.evidence: In photo 0, the brand/model and exact screen size (55 inch) are not readable; the screen is off so 'smart' cannot be verified.

risks.risk: Screen size may not be 55 inches (size not readable from the photo).
risks.proof: A photo with a measuring tape across the screen (corner-to-corner) or the TV model label showing the exact size.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used Samsung smart TV with size uncertainty (worst case: not 55 inches).

risks.risk: Brand/model may not be Samsung (brand not readable).
risks.proof: Photo of the label/sticker on the back or the model number on the TV frame (e.g., 'Model: ...').
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unverified TV brand (worst case: not Samsung).

risks.risk: TV may not be working properly (screen is off; no functional test shown).
risks.proof: Video/clip showing the TV turning on, booting, and displaying a menu (or YouTube app) with sound.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / untested until proven working.

risks.risk: Panel issues (lines, dead pixels, backlight problems) not visible with the screen off.
risks.proof: On-screen test pattern video (solid colors + grid) and close-up of any lines/banding while playing content.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having possible panel faults (worst case: discounted for potential display issues).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (remote, stand, power cable) affecting usability/value.
risks.proof: Photo of all included items laid out (remote, stand/legs, power cable) and ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming remote/stand may be missing (worst case: reduced value).

proof_requests: Photo of the back label showing brand + exact model number (and size).
Video/clip: TV turns on, shows the home/menu screen, and plays audio/video.
On-screen test pattern (solid colors + grid) to check dead pixels/lines/backlight.
Photos of included accessories: remote, stand/legs, power cable.
response.reason: From photo 0, the brand/model and 55-inch size are not readable, and 'smart' plus working condition cannot be verified because the screen is off. To price correctly (worst-case), we need the model label and a working-on test.
